name: super-app-rolim
description: Super App Rolim de Moura — PWA do cidadão e painel da prefeitura sobre Firebase

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix functions install
scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-rolim --only firestore,storage "vitest run --config tests/rules/vitest.config.ts"
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:functions && npm run test:rules
